mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Mail domains and their DNS records, mailboxes, aliases, outbound mail of the sites and logs.
mail.pickAccount: Choose a hosting account to see its outbound mail, site relays and queue.
mail.noAccount: No hosting account is visible to you.
mail.overviewFailed: Failed to load the mail state
mail.localPartInvalid: Lower-case letters, digits and . _ + - only (no dot at the start, the end or twice).

banner.external: DNS only: the mail of this platform is hosted by an external provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365…). The panel publishes the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records you enter for each domain; mailboxes are managed at your provider.
banner.unsupported: The mail engine of this platform ({{engine}}) is not supported by this version: mail is not served. A platform administrator must choose another engine (Settings → Mail service).
banner.outboundSuspended: Outbound mail of this account is suspended: its mailboxes and sites cannot send (messages are still received). See the Outbound tab.

domains.empty: No mail domain yet: enable mail on one of your domains.
domains.loadFailed: Failed to load the mail domains
domains.enabledHint: Off: messages to this domain are refused and its mailboxes cannot sign in.
domains.catchAllHint: Receives the messages sent to unknown addresses of the domain. Empty: they are refused.
domains.pendingHint: The ownership of this domain is not verified yet: the mail domain stays pending (no mail is received or sent) until the verification succeeds on the Domains page.

create.title: Enable mail on a domain
create.noDomain: Every domain of this account already has mail, or it has no domain yet.
create.domainsFailed: Failed to load the domains of the account
create.externalZone: Its DNS zone is not hosted here: the mail records will have to be created at your DNS provider (listed on the next page).
create.failed: Failed to enable mail on the domain

domain.loadFailed: Failed to load the mail domain
domain.notFound: This mail domain does not exist or is not visible to you.
domain.maxSizeHint: Empty: the plan value ({{size}} MB). Never above the plan and platform ceilings.
domain.saveFailed: Failed to save the mail domain
domain.deleteConfirm: Disable mail on {{name}}? Its mail records are removed from the zone and its DKIM keys deleted. Type the domain name to confirm.
domain.deleteForceConfirm: Delete the mail domain {{name}} WITH its {{mailboxes}} mailbox(es) and {{aliases}} alias(es)? Logins stop at once and the messages are purged after 7 days. Type the domain name to confirm.
domain.deleteNotEmpty: Delete its mailboxes and aliases first.
domain.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the mail domain
domain.engineUnknown: The mail engine of the platform could not be determined: the engine-specific settings are hidden.

dns.title: DNS records
dns.loadFailed: Failed to load the DNS records
dns.managedHint: The zone of this domain is hosted on our name servers: these records are written automatically.
dns.externalTitle: To create at your DNS provider
dns.externalHint: The DNS zone of this domain is not hosted here: create the records below at your registrar or DNS provider (copy button on each line), then click « Check now ».
dns.noRecord: No record expected (mail disabled or domain pending).

messages.lookupFailed: The public resolvers did not answer.
messages.mxMismatch: The MX record points to another server.
messages.mxExtra: Other MX records are published next to ours.
messages.spfMultiple: Several SPF records are published: receivers treat this as an error.
messages.spfMismatch: The SPF record does not authorise this server.
messages.spfDiffers: The SPF record differs from the expected one but authorises this server.
messages.dkimMismatch: The published DKIM key is not the expected one.
messages.dmarcDiffers: The DMARC record differs from the expected one.
messages.addressMismatch: The name points to another address.
messages.srvMismatch: The SRV record points to another server or port.
messages.txtMismatch: The record differs from the expected one.
messages.ptrMissing: No reverse DNS (PTR) for this address: ask your hosting provider to set it.
messages.ptrMismatch: The reverse DNS (PTR) of this address is not the mail host name.

dns.shadowedHint: The zone of this domain is hosted on our name servers, but records stored in it override the automatic ones (marked below): use « Fix » to serve the expected records.
dns.shadowedHintReadOnly: The zone of this domain is hosted on our name servers, but records stored in it override the automatic ones (marked below): someone allowed to edit the DNS zone can fix them.

fix.title: Fix the mail records of the zone
fix.intro: Records stored in the zone {{zone}} hide the records this server needs. Ticked lines are removed so that our name servers serve the expected records instead. Other records of the zone are not touched.
fix.notDelegated: The name servers of this domain do not point to ours yet (found: {{found}}). The change is written now and takes effect once the registrar delegates the domain to {{expected}}.
fix.delegationUnknown: The delegation of the domain could not be checked: the change takes effect once the domain points to {{expected}}.
fix.nothing: Nothing to fix: the zone already serves the expected records. A difference seen by « Check now » then comes from the delegation or from the cache of the resolvers.
fix.nothingRemoved: Nothing to remove: the expected record is written again.
fix.ptr: The reverse DNS (PTR) is set at the provider of the server addresses, not in the zone: it cannot be fixed here.
fix.applied: Zone fixed: {{count}} record(s) now served by our name servers

item.mx: Route incoming mail back to this server
item.spf: Authorise this server to send the mail of the domain (SPF)
item.dkim: Publish the DKIM key of this server
item.dmarc: Publish the DMARC policy of the domain

consequence.mx: Incoming mail for {{domain}} will arrive on this server instead of {{hosts}}.
consequence.mxNew: Incoming mail for {{domain}} will arrive on this server.
consequence.spf: Servers previously authorised ({{terms}}) will no longer be: their messages may be rejected or marked as spam.
consequence.dkim: The key published at this name is replaced by the key this server signs with.
consequence.dmarc: The current DMARC policy is replaced by the one of the DNS options of this domain.

blocked.notGenerated: The mail records of this domain are not published (mail disabled, domain not verified or account suspended).
blocked.systemRecord: A record managed by the platform holds this name.
blocked.cnameAtName: A CNAME at this name redirects everything, including the website: change it in the DNS zone.
blocked.stillHidden: Another record would still hide the expected one: check the DNS zone.

ptr.title: Reverse DNS (PTR)
ptr.hint: Receiving servers check that the address of our mail server points back to its name. This record is set at the hosting provider of the server (not in your zone): the panel can only remind it.

dkim.title: DKIM keys
dkim.rotateConfirm: A new key is created and published; it signs the outgoing mail once its DNS record is visible, then the old key is retired after 7 days. If the zone is hosted elsewhere, publish the new record at your provider.
dkim.rotateFailed: Failed to rotate the DKIM key
dkim.loadFailed: Failed to load the DKIM keys
dkim.empty: No DKIM key yet: it is created with the mail domain.
dkim.ed25519Off: Ed25519 (turn it on in the DNS options)

dnsOptions.title: DNS options
dnsOptions.spfExtraHint: Other servers allowed to send for this domain (newsletter service…): include:, ip4:, ip6:, a, mx.
dnsOptions.tlsRptHint: Needs a report address in the platform settings.
dnsOptions.saveFailed: Failed to save the DNS options

external.title: Records of your mail provider
external.hint: Copy here the records given by your provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365…): the panel publishes them in the zone and checks them.
external.noMx: No MX: the domain receives no mail.
external.dkimInvalid: Selector: lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; value starting with v=DKIM1.
external.saveFailed: Failed to save the provider records

flags.importedHint: Password hash imported from another server

mailboxes.noDomain: Enable mail on a domain first (Domains tab).
mailboxes.quotaHint: Capped by the plan of the account (largest mailbox and total mail quota).
mailboxes.deleteConfirm: Delete {{address}}? Logins stop at once and its messages are purged after 7 days. Type the address to confirm.

mailbox.notFound: This mailbox does not exist or is not visible to you.
mailbox.noAlias: No alias delivers to this mailbox.

password.label: Password
password.generateHint: A strong password is generated by the server and shown once.
password.hashHint: Migration: the hash is kept as is (SHA512/256-CRYPT, MD5-CRYPT, BLF-CRYPT, SSHA*), the mailbox keeps its password.
password.changeHint: Open mail clients and webmail sessions will have to sign in again.
password.revealWarning: It is shown only now: the panel keeps only a hash. Copy it into the mail client or a password manager.

forwarding.title: Forwarding
forwarding.hint: Up to {{max}} addresses; no destination to turn forwarding off.
forwarding.keepCopy: Keep a copy in the mailbox

autoresponder.title: Auto-reply
autoresponder.enabledHint: Within the dates below (open-ended when empty).
autoresponder.subject: Subject
autoresponder.badDates: The end must be after the start.

client.title: Mail client settings
client.hint: Thunderbird and Outlook usually configure themselves from the address. Otherwise, enter these values (password = the mailbox password).

webmail.opened: The webmail opens in a new tab.
webmail.unavailableHint: The webmail is not available: a platform administrator must choose and deploy it (Settings → Mail service).
webmail.none: No webmail is configured on this platform.
webmail.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab.

aliases.deleteConfirm: Delete the alias {{address}}? Messages sent to it will be refused.

outbound.title: Outbound mail
outbound.loadFailed: Failed to load the outbound state
outbound.suspendConfirm: The mailboxes and the sites of this account can no longer send (reception continues). Reason (optional, shown to the staff):
outbound.resumeConfirm: The mailboxes and the sites of this account may send again. Make sure the cause (compromised password, spamming script…) is fixed.
outbound.contactSupport: Contact the support to resume sending once the cause is fixed.

reasons.bounceRate: Too many bounces: outbound mail was suspended automatically.
reasons.spamRate: Too many messages flagged as spam: outbound mail was suspended automatically.

relay.title: Site relay (PHP mail())
relay.description: The sites send their PHP mail() through the authenticated relay of the platform: the sender is forced to an address of the account and the volume is limited per site.
relay.loadFailed: Failed to load the site relays
relay.defaultSenderHint: An address of an active mail domain of the account. Empty: noreply@ the first mail domain.
relay.perHourHint: Capped by the plan. Empty: the plan value.
relay.rotateConfirm: New relay credentials are written into the site {{site}} (msmtp); the old ones stop working at once.
relay.siteEmpty: No relay for this site yet.

queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: The queue is empty: every message was delivered.
queue.deleteConfirm: Delete this message of {{sender}} from the queue? It will never be delivered.

logs.loadFailed: Failed to load the mail logs
logs.empty: No log line for these filters.
logs.badDates: The start date must be before the end date.

plan.title: Mail
plan.maxMessageSizeHint: Also capped by the platform setting.
plan.maxMessageSizeRange: Largest mail message: between {{min}} and {{max}} MB.
plan.hint: The mailbox count is set with the limits above. An unlimited mailbox is refused while the total mail quota is capped.

infra.mailHint: Shared mail engine chosen at installation (Postfix + Dovecot with Rspamd, or Stalwart) on the public mail ports 25, 465, 587, 143, 993, 110, 995 and 4190. Its configuration is rebuilt from the panel.
infra.relayHint: Authenticated relay of the PHP mail() of the sites (msmtp), reachable only from the account networks: forces the sender and limits the volume per site.
infra.webmailHint: Shared Roundcube or SnappyMail on the mail network, served on its own host name and opened from the panel without a password.
infra.redeployMailConfirm: The mail engine containers are recreated: the mail service (SMTP, IMAP, POP3) is cut for up to a minute. Sending servers retry their messages, open mail clients reconnect.
infra.redeployRelayConfirm: The site relay is recreated: PHP mail() of the sites fails for a few seconds.
infra.redeployWebmailConfirm: The webmail container is recreated: open webmail sessions are closed.

planLimitDimension.messageSize: This size is above the largest message size of the plan.

errors.forwardingLoop: This destination loops back to the address itself.

errors.hashSchemeUnsupported: The mail engine cannot verify this password hash scheme.
errors.backendUnavailable: The mail service is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
errors.mailEngineInUse: The engine cannot be changed while mailboxes or aliases exist (it would be a migration).
errors.mailEngineNotSupported: This mail engine is not supported by this version yet.
errors.externalOnly: These records only apply to the external mail engine.

errors.outboundSuspended: Outbound mail of this account is suspended.

errors.fixPlanChanged: The zone changed since this preview: review the changes again.

errors.zoneNotHosted: The zone of this domain is hosted elsewhere: change the records at your DNS provider.

mailSettings.title: Mail service
mailSettings.loadFailed: Failed to load the mail settings
mailSettings.saveFailed: Failed to save the mail settings

errors.hostname: Enter a fully qualified host name.

status.title: Mail service
status.description: Shared mail engine (ports 25, 465, 587, 143, 993, 110, 995, 4190), chosen in the setup wizard. The panel is the source of truth: the engine store is rebuilt from it at every synchronisation.
status.loadFailed: Failed to load the mail service status
status.forceConfirm: The whole configuration of the engine is rewritten and reloaded, even if nothing changed. Connections in progress may be cut for a few seconds.
status.ptrHint: Set at the hosting provider of the server: the PTR of each public address must point to the mail host.
status.bans: {{count}} active ban(s) on the mail ports.

engine.title: Mail engine
engine.changeConfirm: The containers of {{from}} are removed (their data is kept on disk) and {{to}} is deployed. The DNS records and certificates are regenerated.
engine.changeFailed: Failed to change the mail engine
engine.locked: The engine can only be changed while no mailbox and no alias exist: changing it afterwards is a migration of the mailboxes, not a switch.

service.title: Mail host and webmail
service.hostnameHint: MX target, SMTP / IMAP server and its certificate. Empty: the panel host ({{panel}}).
service.webmailHint: Shared webmail container, opened from the panel without a password (single sign-on). Changing it redeploys the container.
service.webmailHostnameHint: For example webmail.<platform domain>. Empty: only webmail.<domain> of each mail domain.
service.underPanel: Never the panel host ({{panel}}) nor one of its sub-domains: the webmail would share the panel cookies. It would not be served.
service.perDomainHint: DNS record and certificate added for each active mail domain.
service.panelUnknown: The panel host could not be loaded: the webmail host cannot be checked against it, so a new value cannot be saved. Reload the page.

dns.title: DNS defaults of the mail domains
dns.description: Applied to every mail domain that does not override them (DNS options of the domain).
dns.dmarcHint: p=none until the reports show that every legitimate sender is aligned.
dns.rotationHint: A new key is published, used once visible, the old one retired 7 days later. Off: manual rotation only.

antispam.title: Anti-spam, sizes and retention
antispam.greylistingHint: Unknown senders are asked to retry a few minutes later (delays the first message).
antispam.clamavHint: Incoming messages scanned by the shared scanner (Postfix + Dovecot only; needs the scanner deployed).
antispam.order: The tag score must be lower than the refuse score.
antispam.maxSizeHint: Platform ceiling (plans and domains stay below).
antispam.defaultQuotaHint: When none is given, capped by the plan.

abuse.title: Site relay, abuse and bans
abuse.siteRelay: Sites send through the relay (PHP mail())
abuse.siteRelayHint: msmtp in every site → authenticated relay, sender forced on an address of the account, limit per site. Off: mail() of the sites returns false.
abuse.banHint: Bans apply to the mail ports only (hostd nftables, before Docker); IPv6 per /64; internal addresses are never banned.

bans.title: Mail bans
bans.unbanConfirm: Lift the ban of {{ip}} on the mail ports now?
bans.description: Addresses banned from the mail ports (SMTP, submission, IMAP, POP3) after repeated authentication failures.

relayTest.title: Open relay test
relayTest.description: Connects to the public address of the server like an outsider and checks that no message can be relayed (the dialogue stops before DATA: nothing is sent).
relayTest.ko: OPEN RELAY: the server accepts to relay messages it should refuse.

checks.unauthRelay: Port 25 refuses to relay to an external domain
checks.submissionNoAuth: Port 587 refuses to relay without authentication
checks.submissionNoTls: Port 587 offers no AUTH before STARTTLS
checks.senderMismatch: A mailbox cannot send as another address
